title: Phase 55I completes the 150-candidate review and adds nine bounded records
summary: FTFN completed a first-pass review of all 150 private source candidates, converted ten into active monitoring rails, added nine In Review signals across policy, manufacturing, minerals, agriculture, AI research infrastructure, workforce, water, and electricity, and strengthened the Phoenix water record. No signal moved to Published.
evidence_note: Each addition preserves its conversion boundary: policy is not implementation; funding is not delivery; participation is not impact; regulatory guidance is not product adoption; workforce estimates are not facility sufficiency; and system plans are not project-level utility capacity.
